results.name: BMP: 24-bit bottom-up rows with 4-byte padding (odd widths 1, 2, 3, 37) decode bit-exact in Pillow; alpha composited over white by the documented formula
GIF: ≤ 255 colours are exact (2-, 16-, 200-colour images incl. 1×1 and 600×400 noise past the 4096-code LZW reset) and Pillow decodes them bit-exact
GIF transparency: alpha < 128 → the transparent index (Graphic Control Extension), visible pixels exact; an all-transparent image is valid

GIF photo (> 256 colours): median cut + Floyd–Steinberg — mean error per channel ≤ 6 and 8×8 block-mean error ≤ 0.8 (no diffusion: 2.7; no right-hand term: 0.95) on a smooth 256×256 gradient, ≤ 12 on noise; quantising 1 MP stays < 4 s
refusals: zero / oversized dimensions and short pixel buffers throw instead of writing a broken file
